macro_cross_check.verdict: BREAK EXPLAINED, CALLED OUT LOUDLY: protein -27.4% is outside the 15% instrument, so the main-protein line was re-examined as the rule demands. The pork line is an ABSOLUTE printed weight (2 lb cubed raw), so no each-weight assumption exists to correct. The source's 29.9 g/serving x 8 = 239 g protein is IMPOSSIBLE from 907 g raw pork shoulder (USDA raw max ~158 g, plus ~15 g from everything else = ~173 g total); 239 g back-computes almost exactly to the same 907 g entered as COOKED pork shoulder (USDA cooked ~25.7 P/100 g -> 233 g), a raw/cooked basis flip in the source's own calculator. Cubing happens raw, our raw booking is the physical recipe, and the source label is the number that is wrong. Calories (-21%) and fat (-24%) shift the same direction for the same reason. Carbs run higher than published because the full paste section and the creamed-coconut USDA basis are booked; both are disclosed per-line.
macro_cross_check.band_check: computed 433.8 cal in [400, 650] PASS but with only 34 cal of floor margin - and the pot-true figure (paste overstatement removed, ~406 cal) passes by just 6 cal. If the pricer forces the creamed-coconut fallback to coconut milk, this recipe DROPS BELOW THE FLOOR (~385 cal). Spec lane must re-run the band after the creamed-coconut verdict lands. Carbs 10.6 g <= 35 PASS.
